# Is your property tax assessment too high, and would an appeal pay?

> Free property tax appeal calculator: adjust comparable sales to your home, compare with your assessed value, and see the yearly tax saved, the break-even odds and what an appeal firm would keep. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
